digest.title: NIST Researchers Supersize Quantum Technology to Help Detect Faint Photons

digest.title: Witness XZ Andromedae Wink
digest.summary: Is this star winking at us? The central object in today’s animation is not one but two stars. XZ Andromedae, indicated by the bold lines, is an Algol-type eclipsing binary with a nearly edge-on orbit from Earth’s perspective.
